errors.slugInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
errors.slugReserved: That address is used by an Oxagen page. Pick another.
errors.workspaceNameRequired: Enter a name for the first workspace.
errors.workspaceSlugInvalid: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.workspaceSlugReserved: That address is used by an organization page. Pick another.
errors.slugTaken: That address belongs to another organization. Pick a different one.
errors.agentSlugInvalid: Use up to 18 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
errors.agentNameRequired: Enter a name for the agent.
errors.agentHarnessInvalid: Pick one of the harnesses Oxagen wraps.
errors.failed: The organization could not be created. Nothing was saved; try again.
errors.denied: This account may not create an organization.

organization.title: Name your organization
organization.lead: The organization is the tenant: it owns its own graph database, its own encryption key, its billing account, and the namespace that appears in every agent key.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.slugHint: Oxagen lives at /{slug}. You can change the address later.
organization.workspaceHint: A workspace is a governance partition: one main repo, one ontology, one steering set, its own agents, tool grants and budgets.
organization.creates: Creates the organization {name} and its first workspace.

gate.title: Finish setting up this workspace
gate.lead: Oxagen opens when an agent you wrapped has talked to it. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test, so one path covers both.

subs.organization: Tenant, namespace and the first workspace
subs.wrap: Claude Code, an SDK agent or your own loop
subs.run: The first frame is what opens Oxagen

provisional.title: {workspace} is provisional until {until}
provisional.body: Runs record and spend counts. Steering, context records and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound, because there is nowhere to publish them to.
provisional.noRepository: No enrolled host has reported a GitHub remote for this workspace. Bind its main repository from Workspace settings, or from the register flow once a host has reported one.

firstRun.title: The first frame arrived
firstRun.body: This workspace recorded <run></run> when the gate opened. The tiles below read off the runs it has kept since.

register.caption: Registration does not complete until the agent has talked to Oxagen. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test, so there is one path, not two. Cancel at any time.

noAgent.title: No agent to wrap yet
noAgent.body: This step works on the identity the first step mints. Start from Name the agent.

denied.title: You cannot see agent registration
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.dialogBody: Oxagen cannot send an access request from this page yet. Ask an organization owner to grant {permission}. The grant lands in the audit record.

name.title: Name the agent
name.lead: The key is reserved now and is immutable.
name.workspaceHint: Its definition file lands in .oxagen/agents/ in the main repo.
name.harnessHint: Picks the installer on the next step.
name.tierHint: The harness calls the model with its own key. The tier is recorded on every frame.
name.tierNotSent: Oxagen stores no model tier at registration yet, so this choice is not sent.
name.note: Continue reserves <mono>{key}</mono> by registering its identity. The definition file is committed in a separate pull request.
name.reserved: <mono>{key}</mono> is reserved. Continue opens the wrap step.

wrap.title: Wrap the agent
wrap.lead: The enrollment token for <mono>{key}</mono> is single use, so the machine that presents it becomes this agent's host.

body.claude-code: Enrolling writes the Claude Code hooks and enrolls this host with its own device key. The hooks report every session to Oxagen through the tachod collector.
body.codex: The same enrollment, with the Codex profile. It writes ~/.codex/config.toml: the Oxagen MCP server, the notify hook to the collector, and the approval policy routed through Oxagen.
body.cursor: The same enrollment, with the Cursor profile. It writes ~/.cursor/hooks.json, which the IDE and cursor-agent both read. Cursor has no ask step, so a policy that asks is answered deny with the reason.
body.sdk: Your own process calls Oxagen with the agent credential: the frames it sends, the checkpoint before each turn, and the Oxagen MCP endpoint as the agent's tool server. Works with the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Claude Agent SDK, Stella, and any custom loop.

wrap.tierNote: The tier is computed per run from what was actually routed, never from what the adapter can do on paper. Hooks deliver steering and can refuse at four events, client-attested and fail-open. No report can render a stronger word than the tier allows.
wrap.codexNote: Which of the two the native tools earn depends on the harness version. On versions that do not expose an approval hook the agent is recorded only, and the run says so.
wrap.cursorNote: Cursor's model calls do not pass through the Oxagen gateway, so its spend is not metered.

download.notPublished: Signed installers with the token embedded are not published yet. Issue the token and run the command below.

credential.label: issued once to the operator
credential.use: Set it as OXAGEN_AGENT_TOKEN. Oxagen mints short-lived run tokens from it at run start. Revoking the credential kills every run token at the next call.
credential.issueNote: Issuing a new credential retires the one before it.
credential.sdkNotPublished: The Oxagen SDK and its five-line wrap are not published yet, so there is nothing to install or copy.

wrap.caption: Nothing completes until a frame arrives.

run.title: Wait for the first frame
run.lead: Registration completes the moment the first frame from <mono>{key}</mono> reaches Oxagen and lands you on Fleet looking at its run.

waiting.title: Waiting for the first frame
waiting.start: Start {harness} in any repository on <host>{hostname}</host>. This card flips on its own when the first frame lands.
waiting.none: No host has enrolled for this agent. The token from the previous step is what enrols one.

log.hooksMissing: hooks missing · calls they do not route are recorded, not governed
log.notRecorded: The collector's own log is not recorded yet, so only the lines Oxagen holds are shown.

run.caption: There is no Done button. The frame is the completion.

received.title: First frame received
received.routed: The tier is computed from what was actually routed, not from what the adapter can do on paper.
received.harness: The hooks answered, so this run is harness: delivered, recorded, client-attested, fail-open.
received.chainGaps: {count, plural, one {# frame missing} other {# frames missing}}

error.title: The first frame cannot be read

failure.orgRoleRequired: This account may not register agents here. An organization owner or admin can.
failure.noPrincipal: The call carried no person Oxagen could check a role for. Nothing ran.
failure.agentNotFound: That agent is not in this workspace. Nothing was written.
failure.slugTaken: An agent in this workspace already holds that slug. Pick another.
failure.gateNotFound: This workspace is not the organization's onboarding workspace, so it has no gate to move.
failure.alreadyUnlocked: The gate is already open. Oxagen is unlocked.
failure.firstFrameRequired: The run step completes when the first frame arrives. It cannot be skipped.
failure.githubNotConnected: No GitHub App installation reaches this workspace. Connect GitHub, then bind the repository.
failure.repositoryNotInstalled: This workspace's GitHub App installation cannot see that repository.
failure.mainRepoBound: This workspace already binds a different main repository.
failure.refused: The write was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: The form was refused before the write ran. Check the fields above.
failure.pendingApproval: The write is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The write did not complete: {code}. Nothing was changed.
